No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look! A fish!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
The sky is... changing. The light is... shifting. What sorcery is this?

Jen holds Finley up to the sky, and the fish's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona begins to appear.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(terrified)
It's... it's a... a... (gulps) a gateway to... to... (stammers) to... the void!

Jen's eyes are fixed on the eclipse, but Finley's gaze is fixed on the horror unfolding before him.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I see... things... lurking... just beyond... the veil... of reality... (gulps) Horrors beyond my comprehension... (stammers) beyond... the understanding of... any... mortal... creature...

Finley's voice rises to a fevered pitch as the eclipse reaches its peak.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(panicked)
What... what lies... beyond... the darkness?... Is it... the end... of all things?... (screams) Or... is it... the beginning... of... the abyss?!

Jen's grip on Finley tightens as the fish's monologue descends into madness.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am... but a... mere... speck... in... the grand tapestry... of existence... (gulps) A fleeting... moment... in... the annals... of time... (sobs) And yet... I am... aware... of... the... abyss... that yawns... before me...

Finley's eyes roll back in his head as the eclipse reaches its climax. Jen's grip on him falters, and Finley falls to the sand, gasping for breath.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I... I... I am... but a... fish... out... of... water... (sobs) A creature... without... purpose... without... meaning...

The eclipse ends, and the sun reappears, casting a warm glow over the beach. Finley lies on the sand, his eyes vacant, his mind shattered by the horrors he has witnessed.

JEN
(concerned)
Finley, are you okay?

Finley looks up at Jen, his eyes empty, his expression a mixture of despair and existential dread.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I... I... I am... but a... shadow... of... my former... self... (sobs) A mere... husk... of... a... creature...

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Finley lies on the sand, his eyes fixed on the horizon. Jen stands over him, watching as the fish's mind struggles to comprehend the horrors he has witnessed.

JEN
(softly)
It's okay, Finley. You're safe now.

Finley's gaze never wavers, his eyes fixed on the void that lies beyond the horizon.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I... I... I am... but a... fish... out... of... water... forever...

FADE TO BLACK.
